title: 91. Median of Two Sorted Arrays

examples.explanation: The combined sorted array is [1, 2, 3]. With 3 elements, the median is the middle value, 2.0.
The combined sorted array is [1, 2, 3, 4]. With 4 elements, the median is the average of the two middle values, 2.5.
The combined sorted array is [1]. With 1 element, the median is the only value, 1.0.

hints: Binary-search a partition in the shorter array and infer the matching partition in the longer array.
A partition is valid when every value on the left is no greater than every value on the right.
Use wide integer arithmetic before averaging the two middle values to avoid overflow.
